title: cli test: data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts times out its hook at 480 s in a merge-queue Test Core shard
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpRrYuqSLCvbSk9zrL

**Flake report, untriaged.** Filed by zone a4-K, which owns none of this code. Routed to triage.

## What failed

A merge-queue build of #37155 (queue commit `a261b475eb`, run [45528039199](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45528039199), job `Test Core (5/10)` [138917103959](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45528039199/job/138917103959)), step "Run this shard's tests":

```
@objectstack/cli:test:  ❯ integration  src/commands/migrate/data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts (54 tests | 41 skipped) 585325ms
@objectstack/cli:test:  FAIL  integration  src/commands/migrate/data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts > [#21552] the rest of the family: a project with no database yet is empty work, exit 0
@objectstack/cli:test: Error: Hook timed out in 480000ms.
@objectstack/cli:test:  ❯ src/commands/migrate/data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts:703:3
```

## Why it reads as a flake, not a regression

- #37155 touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` and one driver-sql test. It changes nothing in `packages/cli`.
- The failure is a hook **timeout**, not an assertion. The file ran 585 s in total, under full-suite queue load.
- The merge-queue triage comment on #37155 (7150528961) records this signature once in its 24 h window. That window's ledger was not read to the end, so the count is a lower bound.

## Not done here

No reproduction and no fix: the code is outside the filing zone. A search for an open card on this signature (`absent-database`, `data-commands` timeout) found none. The closest closed precedents on cli suites timing out under shard load are #25499 and #27306.
